summary: Verified the cemetery vine canopy bug fix on /cementerio. Full-width canopy (1920x280) drapes from the top across entire page, is pointer-events:none, and does not clip. Side vines (VineSide) visible on left/right edges on desktop. Dino cards remain clickable — profile modal opens. Search, status tabs, filters, and fossil-panel buttons all functional. No overflow-hidden clipping. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Cementerio.jsx is ~635 lines — consider extracting DinoCard, ProfileModal, FossilPanel, HallOfFame into separate files for maintainability (guideline: >700 lines threshold, this is borderline).
Canopy fixed at viewBox 1600 with preserveAspectRatio='none' stretches to 1920 — acceptable since strands are decorative, but on ultrawide monitors strand geometry may stretch.
seed_data_creation: Used existing demo account (POST /api/auth/demo via 'Probar cuenta demo' button) which owns 12 seeded cemetery records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canopy verified: bbox {x:0,y:68,width:1920,height:280}, pointer-events:none, overflow:visible. 12 dino cards render, first card click opens cemetery-profile-modal successfully. All fossil panel and filter controls interactive.
